sources.title: NIKH 1894 old-calendar July 12 early gazette proposal includes four-clause Seongeo Jorye and Jeongog-guk Jorye
sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History, official early gazette digitized text
sources.quality_notes: Full 選擧條例 four provisions appointing by ministers, personnel nominations, ordinary then special exam, temporary 鄕貢法; separately 銓考局條例 defines general 國文/漢文/寫字/算術/政略/外國事情 and post-general special abilities testing. Recorded as 草記 proposals. Does not name Myeonggwa textbook, nor prove actual individual exams. No original printed physical folio image reviewed.

sources.title: AKS modern encyclopedia Seongeo Jorye 1894 four-article establishment and examination mechanism
sources.provider: Academy of Korean Studies historical encyclopedia authored 2021 revised 2022
sources.quality_notes: Modern entry calls July12 regulation enacted and describes old civil examination replacement through ministerial nominations and ordinary/special examination. It is not an additional 1894 legal sheet, and does not resolve Myeonggwa continued use or private teaching.

sources.title: NIKH Gojong Sillok 1895 third-month twenty-fifth edict 47 Gwansangso ordinance 7 articles
sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History, Gojong Sillok official digitized received text
sources.quality_notes: Edict 47 approved/promulgated Gwansangso under Hakbu to handle observation, meteorology and almanac compilation; Article 6 leaves subdivision to minister, Article 7 effective year 504 fourth month first day; original physical folio of Sillok not independently inspected. Does not by itself adjudicate Myeonggwa subject-specific termination or instruction lineage.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: the new 1894 ministerial ordinary/special examination is not a proved specific Myeonggwa course or Ziwei/Ziping natal rule
1895 observatory edict lists meteorology and calendars while allowing minister-designated subdivisions, so missing named Myeonggwa is not a standalone proof of historical nonexistence
unresolved_lineage_questions: post-1894 Myeonggwa professional exam policy or examination script
